tasks.design: The industrial-organizational psychologist assesses employee performance in person. That assessment is the act. Nothing in it is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether this employee's work meets the role is a judgement only the psychologist accountable for that assessment can make.
tasks.enabler_now: Class amplify and a judgement-step score of 0.91 are priors. The digest keeps selection, performance, and eligibility as judgement steps. Test scoring against norm tables, speech-to-note, literature screening, qualitative coding, and survey coding cover other tasks in this group. Clinic note times are a different occupation's encounters. This assessment stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Judging this employee's performance when a wrong call can harm that person.
tasks.human_edge: Being the person who weighs this employee's work against the role.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The industrial-organizational psychologist still assesses employee performance.

reach.task: Assess a person in a clinical session
reach.learn: Learn how that assessment is about distress and care, then compare it with a judgement of how an employee is performing at work.

evidence.claim: Assessing employee performance is a judgement the psychologist makes. Scoring a test against a norm table, and speech-driven clinical notes, are different acts and do not replace that judgement.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the industrial-organizational psychologist assesses employee performance in person. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a manager's note is missing she still assesses from the evidence in front of her. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this employer already asks her to score a published test against its norm table inside this performance assessment.
research_questions: Does this employer ask the psychologist to score a published test against its norm table when she assesses employee performance?

already_counted.description: Assessing employee performance remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The psychologist still assesses employee performance in person. No second write-up of that assessment goes away. A conservative case is a monthly round of performance conversations with one team, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: The industrial-organizational psychologist identifies training and development needs in person. That identification is the act. Nothing in it is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Which skill gap is a training need, and which is a job-design or staffing problem, is a judgement only this psychologist can make for that team.
tasks.enabler_now: Class amplify and a judgement-step score of 0.72 are priors. The digest keeps performance and eligibility as judgement, and it does not document a second entry of training needs that this psychologist already makes. Survey theme tools and qualitative coding cover other tasks in this group. This identification stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding which gap is a real training or development need for this team.
tasks.human_edge: Being the person who has watched the work and heard the managers.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The industrial-organizational psychologist still identifies training and development needs.

reach.task: Identify training needed to do hazardous work safely
reach.learn: Learn how that specialist names a safety-skill gap, then compare it with a development need that is not about hazards.

evidence.claim: Identifying training and development needs is a judgement from observed work and role expectations. Theme tools for open survey text do not make that judgement for a workplace team.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the industrial-organizational psychologist identifies training and development needs in person. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a manager has not written a gap note she still identifies needs from the work she sees. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether managers at this employer already hand her a written set of skill gaps before she identifies needs.
research_questions: Do managers at this employer hand the psychologist a written set of skill gaps before she identifies training and development needs?

already_counted.description: Identifying training and development needs remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The psychologist still identifies training and development needs in person. No second write-up of those needs goes away. A conservative case is one needs review after a team misses a skill on a live job, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Formulate training programs, applying principles of learning and individual differences.
Then implement those training programs with the managers and employees who will use them.

tasks.design: The industrial-organizational psychologist formulates the training program on a document, applying principles of learning and individual differences, then implements it in person. Both acts stay hers. Nothing in them is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: How a program should teach this group, given how these adults learn and differ, is a judgement she has to supply herself.
tasks.enabler_now: Class amplify and an artefact-generator score of 0.89 are priors. A machine writing the program she would still have to specify does not remove that work. The digest's writing aids cover literature and grants, not workplace training built on learning principles. This formulation and this implementation stay as they are.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing how this group should learn, then running the program with them.
tasks.human_edge: Being the person who knows these learners and stands in the room.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The industrial-organizational psychologist still formulates and implements the training program.

reach.task: Shape learning support for one pupil
reach.learn: Learn how that psychologist shapes support for a pupil, then compare it with a workplace training program for adults.

evidence.claim: Formulating and implementing a workplace training program is the psychologist applying learning principles to a known group. Writing aids aimed at literature and grant text do not do that program.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the industrial-organizational psychologist formulates the training program and implements it with the people who will use it. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a needs note is thin she still formulates from what she has seen. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether a separate trainer at this employer runs the sessions after she has formulated the program.
research_questions: Does a separate trainer at this employer run the sessions after the psychologist formulates the training program?

already_counted.description: Formulating and implementing the training program remains in these steps.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The psychologist still formulates the training program and still implements it in person. No second write-up of that program goes away. A conservative case is one program for a team whose experience differs widely, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Study organizational effectiveness, productivity, and efficiency, including the nature of workplace supervision and leadership.

tasks.design: The industrial-organizational psychologist studies organizational effectiveness, productivity, and efficiency, including workplace supervision and leadership. That study is the act. Nothing in it is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: What the figures and the supervision mean for this workplace is a judgement only the psychologist who studied it can make.
tasks.enabler_now: Class amplify and a dashboard score of 0.42 are priors. The digest's analysis scripts and traffic models cover forecasts and other tasks, not this study of supervision and leadership. No live board that she already maintains is documented for this task. The study stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Judging what effectiveness, productivity, efficiency, supervision, and leadership mean here.
tasks.human_edge: Being the person who studied this workplace and will stand behind the conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The industrial-organizational psychologist still studies organizational effectiveness, productivity, efficiency, supervision, and leadership.

reach.task: Study a population with a questionnaire
reach.learn: Learn how that researcher studies people through a questionnaire, then compare it with a study of workplace supervision and leadership.

evidence.claim: Studying organizational effectiveness, productivity, efficiency, supervision, and leadership is research judgement. Forecast scripts and traffic models do not do that study.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the industrial-organizational psychologist studies organizational effectiveness, productivity, efficiency, supervision, and leadership. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a productivity figure is missing she still studies from the workplace in front of her. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this employer already keeps a live productivity board that she only reads during the study.
research_questions: Does this employer already keep a live productivity board that the psychologist only reads while she studies organizational effectiveness?

already_counted.description: Studying organizational effectiveness, productivity, efficiency, supervision, and leadership remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The psychologist still studies organizational effectiveness, productivity, efficiency, supervision, and leadership. No second write-up of that study goes away. A conservative case is one study of how a department is supervised, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Performance assessment, training-need judgement, training programs, and organizational studies stay with the industrial-organizational psychologist. The week stays there. No decision right moves.
skills_to_grow: Judge how an employee is performing against the role
Tell a training need from a job-design or staffing problem
Build a training program around how these adults learn
Conclude what supervision and leadership mean for this workplace
role.ambitious_version: The industrial-organizational psychologist still assesses performance, still identifies training and development needs, still formulates and implements training programs, and still studies organizational effectiveness. No machine takes those acts.
